title: Coordinator todo: checks, fixes and open decisions
how_to_use: The coordinator keeps this list current (docs PR). Product ideas live in backlog-todo.json, agent tooling in tooling-todo.json; items here may point to them. Statuses: todo, in_progress, waiting_owner, backlog, deferred, done. Done items stay one week, then are removed.

items.title: After the v0.1.129 nightly fetch: admission_decisions pending falls from 516 to about 70; the 445 openai_news rows are settled as stale_pending and their attempts stop growing; nightly fetch, digest and archive green
items.result: Night of 2026-10-28 on v0.1.132: admission pending 516 -> 72, openai_news pending 0, stale_pending 763 -> 1208; fetch, digest (86 in scope), archive (coverage 95.7%) green; fetch_run_finished shows fetched 4225, examined 1769, sources_fetched 152.

items.title: `ai-news archive status` (with APP_IMAGE): coverage_pct >= 90 over 7 nights (SC-002), gave_up counts (22 openai.com documents fail with http_403 and are expected to give up), top hosts without text
items.note: The 4014 pending archive documents are the old articles of the 2026-10-24 seed (capture --all --no-download); only documents first seen within ARCHIVE_LOOKBACK_DAYS are due, so they stay pending by design. Decided 2026-10-27 (agent): no one-off download of them.
items.result: Checked 2026-10-28: coverage 95.7% (600/627), every day >= 91%, gave_up 0, no outage; 29 documents failed http_403 (22 openai.com, expected to give up); the 4020 pending are the old 2026-10-24 seed and stay pending by design.

items.title: scripts/db_maintenance.sh size loop: above DB_MAX_SIZE_GB it lowers retention step by step, but pruned rows now move into the archive, so the DB does not shrink and the loop may prune far more than needed
items.result: PR #120 (v0.1.130): the size loop stops when a prune does not reduce the DB size. Prod DB 179 MB of the 5 GB limit; the loop has never fired.

items.title: 016 capture: timeouts on every host (ConnectTimeout/ReadTimeout) are not seen as an outage by the shared SourcePageDownloader, so they count as attempts; a few such nights make articles give up for good
items.result: PR #118 (v0.1.130): httpx timeouts count toward the downloader outage (OUTAGE_HOSTS = 10) like ConnectError, also for daily-publish.

items.title: Pipeline findings: 'fetched' counts; missing source_fetch_finished on a failed fetch with admission off; FetchSummary.source_count after a pause; fetch_failure treated as complete coverage
items.result: PR #123 (v0.1.131): new log fields examined_items (source_fetch_finished), examined and sources_fetched (fetch_run_finished); source_fetch_finished also for a failed fetch with admission off; old fields unchanged. Finding 4 (fetch_failure counted as complete weekly coverage) not changed: weekly does not run on prod; moved to B2.

items.title: Articles with a publication date in the future (two alan-turing-institute ai-rss-feed-5 items dated 2026-10-31 on 2026-10-23). Proposal: store the collection time instead of a future date. Reader-visible
items.result: PR #119 (v0.1.130): a publication date more than FUTURE_DATE_TOLERANCE (24 h) ahead becomes the collection time; the original is kept in date_provenance. Owner 2026-10-27: the 45 stored articles with published_at > discovered_at + 24 h are not changed.

items.title: Source onboarding: an HTML candidate is validated by a single link; three URL normalizations (normalize_candidate_url, _url_key, canonicalize_url)
